headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to focus on environmental justice, meaning fair treatment of all communities on environmental issues.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to renew and strengthen their work on environmental justice. Environmental justice generally means that no group of people should bear an unfair share of pollution or other environmental harms. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, offices, or deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are expected to give more weight to environmental justice in how they carry out their work.

who_it_affects.group: Communities facing high levels of pollution or environmental hazards
who_it_affects.how: These communities are the likely focus of the federal attention the order calls for.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 21, 2023; the source does not state a separate effective date.
